response.overview: H. Amir inherited the title of "Tuan Guru" from his grandfather, making him a revered figure in the Pemenang community. The religious teachings and sermons he leads, regularly held at his home, have garnered a significant following. On the other hand, North Lombok is internationally known for its three "Gili Islands": Gili Air, Gili Meno, and Gili Trawangan, which have become global tourist destinations. These three islands serve as gateways for various cultures from around the world, either clashing with or integrating into the local community. Imam Hujattul Islam, a man with a passion for painting like other Pemenang youths, seeks his identity amidst the vibrant cultural exchanges in this region. Yet, he also carries the lineage of a Tuan Guru, a legacy that shapes his journey of self-discovery.
